name: 37203 · Nashville, TN
findings: ZIP 37203 (Nashville) has 305 nonprofit organizations. 141 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 115 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37203 (Nashville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37203 (Nashville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
